name: invoke-human
description: Ask a person and get the answer back. Desktop bundle for an agent key.
long_description: Invoke Human sends a question to the signed-in person's Apple devices, or to a browser, and returns the answer. Connect Claude to https://invokehumantool.com/mcp when you want OAuth. This bundle is a local stdio proxy for an agent key you already have. The directory listing uses the remote URL, not this file. MCPB manifest 0.4 still requires a local process. A remote URL is not a manifest field.

tools.name: send_handoff
tools.description: Send a worksheet, form, approval, review, or sketch.

tools.name: send_html_handoff
tools.description: Send a form the person taps or types.

tools.name: validate_ui
tools.description: Check a HUI document without sending it.

tools.name: share_handoff
tools.description: Invite more people to a handoff.

tools.name: delegate_handoff
tools.description: Forward a handoff you can reassign.

tools.name: wait_for_handoff
tools.description: Wait until the handoff is submitted.

handoffs_token.title: Agent key
handoffs_token.description: Optional agent key (wk_...). Leave this blank and connect https://invokehumantool.com/mcp as a custom connector when you want OAuth instead of this bundle.
